fields.acceptance: daemon-request-slot.txtar (or a new daemon-queued-start-slot.txtar) with a fake rex and no ready change sets: with max-runs 2, two runs queued with rhiza run start on draft change sets and no request, daemon --once starts both; with the same two queued and one queued request, daemon --once starts one queued run and the request's plan run, and the other queued start stays in the queue (it starts on a later poll once a slot frees); with max-runs 1, one queued start and a queued request, it starts the queued run and the request stays queued
fields.statement: While a queued plan request could start (daemonRequestWaits: no run, its retry time passed) and max-runs is above 1, the daemon starts owner-queued runs (rhiza run start, plan and plan-review runs of drafts included) only while fewer than max-runs minus 1 runs run, so one slot stays for the request's plan run; a queued start held back stays queued for a later poll. The poll order (ship picks, queued continuations, queued starts, plan requests) is unchanged, and with max-runs 1 or no request waiting, queued starts fill every free slot as before
